primary_audience: Design directors, VP of Product, venture partners, and cutting-edge design studios

aesthetic_direction.typography: Expressive mono or neo-grotesque display (e.g. Monument Extended or Neue Haas Grotesk) paired with crisp monospaced code elements (e.g. JetBrains Mono)
aesthetic_direction.composition: Dark mode default, asymmetric full-bleed interactive project rows, live interactive UI micro-prototypes, and dense case study typography

required_pages.name: home
required_pages.role: Curated body of work & design ethos

required_pages.name: case-study
required_pages.role: Deep dive into problem, craft, systems & metrics

media_guidelines: Pixel-perfect Figma/code renders, recorded vector micro-interactions, dark UI mockups with high contrast. No generic cartoon avatars or Dribbble spheres.
anti_patterns: Generic circular headshot with floating skill badges
All case study cards having identical 3-column layouts
